name: Hotel Garni Almfried
beschreibung: Hotel Garni Almfried enjoys a peaceful location in the picturesque Paznaun Valley in the Landeck district of Tyrol. Surrounded by alpine peaks, the property provides convenient access to extensive summer hiking trails and renowned ski domains such as Ischgl. Amenities include comfortable guest rooms, a hearty daily breakfast buffet, and complimentary Wi-Fi, offering a relaxed and self-directed mountain stay.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Garni Almfried offers quiet bed-and-breakfast lodging in the Paznaun Valley, with easy access to premier ski resorts around Ischgl and alpine trails.
